steps: Go to Applications > Applications
Create a new app integration > API Services
Select 'SCIM Provisioning'
Enable SCIM provisioning
Copy the SCIM service URL and bearer token above
In Okta, configure the SCIM connection with these credentials
Enable 'Push Groups' for group synchronization
Enable 'Push New Users' and 'Push Profile Updates'

azure.title: Azure AD SCIM Setup
steps: Go to Azure Active Directory > Enterprise applications
Add a new application > 'Integration of any other application you don't find'
Name it 'Nexary SCIM'
Go to 'Provisioning' > 'Automatic user provisioning'
Set Provisioning mode to 'Automatic'
Set SCIM URL to the URL above
Set Secret Token to the bearer token above
Enable the provisioning features you need
Test the connection
Save the configuration

google.title: Google Workspace SCIM Setup
steps: Go to Admin Console > Apps > Web and mobile apps
Add a custom SAML app (or use existing)
Go to SCIM provisioning
Enable SCIM provisioning
Set the SCIM URL to the URL above
Use OAuth 2.0 authentication with the bearer token
Map user attributes
Save the configuration
